integrity: The claims are mathematical derivations, supported by a fully enumerated finite-size checker and independently stated proofs. The limiting claims are analytic and not inferred from finite computations. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Independent equal-probability oriented arcs on simple cycles only. Gumbel limit assumes near-perfect retention with diverging missing-edge count. Historical priority, especially directed-ring reliability and Bernoulli-run consequences, is not independently certified.
title: Exact connectivity and a Poisson-spacing crossover for bidirected cycle percolation
